_about: Hindcast default parameter space, tier A (ShadowLoop proposal section 4, DESIGN.md section 5.4).
One entry per VDF key "<array> <item>": type float/int (low, high, step: the searched step grid), bool, or
choice (explicit values). "phone" is the current value in ns_settings.json (the centre of the one-at-a-time
screen and the sentinel); regenerate with `python -m hindcast.space --write-defaults` after a preferences import.
Constraints are ordering chains the sampler keeps by construction. Locked keys (DESIGN.md section 3: safety
section, profile sens/carb_ratio/current_basal/dia, every new_parameter key) are refused and never listed here.
This file says what a replay may vary; it recommends nothing. Nothing in Hindcast changes the phone.
Tier A: the autoISF caps and weights with the most leverage, plus the SMB delivery-ratio family.

profile autoISF_max._note: caps every weight; when the factor sits on the cap in > 25 % of loops the weights are unobservable (vary the cap first)

profile autoISF_min._note: floor of the ISF factor (hypo side)

profile bgBrake_ISF_weight._note: hypo side of the acceleration term

profile smb_delivery_ratio._note: with _min / _max / _bg_range (the interpolation); chain min <= ratio <= max

profile smb_delivery_ratio_min._note: lower end of the delivery-ratio interpolation

profile smb_delivery_ratio_max._note: upper end of the delivery-ratio interpolation

profile smb_delivery_ratio_bg_range._note: mg/dl; the phone value is itself fitted to the echoes (_assumed / _overrides in ns_settings.json)

profile iob_threshold_percent._note: gates SMB entirely above the threshold (iobTH)
